declarations.name: AuiWaterfallChart

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby).

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (aria-describedby).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for values in tooltips, labels, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

inputs.name: steps
inputs.description: Steps in order: { id, label, value?: number | null, kind?: 'delta' | 'total' }. Ids are unique and non-empty. delta (default): the change (null: a gap, the running total carries over). total: with a value, the running total becomes it (an opening balance); without, the bar shows the current running total.

inputs.name: colors
inputs.description: Palette slots (1-8) per step kind. Default increase 3, decrease 2, total 1.

inputs.name: categoryAxis
inputs.description: Category axis title (also the first table column header; default "Category").

inputs.name: valueAxis
inputs.description: Value axis title, fixed domain, and tick count (2-20). The domain always includes zero.

inputs.name: annotations
inputs.description: Reference lines ({ type: 'line', axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label?, tone? }) and bands ({ type: 'band', axis, from, to, label?, tone? }); tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'. x values are step labels or indexes; y values are numbers. Drawn under the marks (aria-hidden); listed in the accessible summary.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Legend of the step kinds present (Increase, Decrease, Total); not toggleable. auto and show display it, hide removes it.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback with the exact data: behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Texture fills (and dash patterns for lines) so marks never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors).

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: valueLabels
inputs.description: Signed change (deltas) or total printed above the bar (below for decreases and negative totals); a label wider than the step is omitted.

inputs.name: connectors
inputs.description: Dashed connectors (aria-hidden) from each step to the next at the running total; none into a total step.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl mirrors the category axis (first step at the right), puts the value axis on the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Accepted and validated (string[]) for the shared chart contract; a waterfall has no series, so it has no effect.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Inherited from the shared chart controller; no visible effect (a waterfall has no series).

accessibility.pattern: SVG chart as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription) of role="img" data marks with roving focus; data table fallback (native table). Follows the WAI Complex Images tutorial (short name plus long description) and the roving tabindex technique of WAI-ARIA APG.

limitations: One sequence per chart (no series, no legend toggling).
Total steps always drop to zero; subtotals are totals without a value.
Value labels are omitted when wider than the step.
